crossRefs.note: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

translations.web: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
translations.bsb: In the third month they began building up the heaps, and they finished in the seventh month.
translations.kjv: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
translations.asv: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
